checks.message: Provisional boundary is consistently labelled and awaits official replacement.
All three key areas remain provisional and carry no approval claim.
Land-use partition remains derived from and within the provisional site polygon.
Twelve scenarios include the mandatory handover fields.
Every scenario states human takeover and a non-digital fallback.
Maintenance, recovery, exit and asset disposition are explicit.
Static offline HTML has no remote scripts, maps, fonts, forms or tracking.
Proposal cites standards, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions.
